name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Marketing Operations | Conversion Tracking, Ad Platform Integrations, HubSpot & Salesforce
summary: Marketing operations builder who owns the stack as a team of one. I install and debug conversion tracking myself (GA4 events, Meta Pixel, and Google Ads conversion tags through custom GTM triggers and variables, validated in Preview mode and the browser network tab), enforce UTM conventions, and work hands-on in HubSpot and Salesforce. At Level Agency I ran paid campaigns on accounts spending $20K+/month, peaking above $100K. I build funnel and spend reporting in Power BI and SQL and turn it into recommendations leadership can act on.
